status: initial implementation; no external consumer agreement claimed

request.identifiers: 1-64 ASCII letters, digits, dot, underscore or hyphen
request.encoding: single UTF-8 JSON object in one ZeroMQ frame

response.observed_at: UTC ISO-8601 timestamp; observation time, not last native progress
response.request_id: echo valid ID; null if not recoverable from malformed input
response.adapter_boot_id: random 128-bit identity per adapter process, not worker identity

worker_observation.ready: boolean from health endpoint or null
worker_observation.busy: boolean derived from active field or null
worker_observation.queued: nonnegative integer from health endpoint or null
worker_observation.worker_generation: nonnegative local generation counter or null; not globally unique boot identity

semantics: ok means control operation succeeded, not worker readiness or model numerical certification
Absent worker measurements remain null; registration never certifies capabilities
No cached worker observations; clients retain their own last-success and freshness
Oversized frames are disconnected by libzmq; multipart is rejected by socket reset, without a response
Clients must close and recreate REQ sockets after timeout
Remote exposure is unsupported; authentication and approved-peer policy are required before adding it
